title: PAR-138 order-independent DXF view-style name association
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Populate typed DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle names from the Autodesk-defined NOD and child-DICTIONARY graph without depending on OBJECTS record order.

changes.representation: The typed DXF style name is copied from the unique group-3 DICTIONARY entry associated by group-350 target handle; no group-2 style-object name is assumed.
changes.association: Resolve fixed ASCII ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE / ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE root keys, validate child dictionary ownership by the NOD handle, and match style handle plus owner handle.
changes.orderHandling: Stage style callbacks only while an earlier style-name association is unresolved. A FIFO queue preserves relative style callback order and typed/raw callback adjacency; it is capped at DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries (100000) and unresolved callbacks flush with empty names at OBJECTS end.
ambiguityHandling: detail and section roots sharing a child dictionary handle
missing child dictionary or style entry
changes.duplicateNamePolicy: Exact entry spelling is preserved. ASCII case variants are detected for duplicate-key refusal; full Unicode case folding is not claimed.
negativeControls: duplicate case-insensitive child key targeting another style
positiveControls: exact style-key rename reflected in the typed name
same-version export/readback after reversed record order
changes.worktreeNote: The checkout was already broadly dirty and the .git directory is read-only in this session. No staging or commit was attempted.

focusedSelector.expectedMalformedInputDiagnostics: The selector prints DXF format errors for intentionally malformed input controls and exits successfully after confirming names remain unresolved.

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- src/libdxfrw.cpp src/libdxfrw.h tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

evidenceLimit: This proves a typed DXF name handoff and generated same-version raw replay behavior. It does not implement DWG-origin Name decoding or typed style serialization, qualify native style rendering, or promote any consumer support claim.

remainingPAR138Work: DWG-origin style-name decoding and producer/spec-backed field mapping
typed style serialization and its version gates
